asset.name: useAsyncAction
asset.description: The standardized async-operation controller covering pending, progress, success, failure, cancellation, retry, optimistic update, rollback, and stale-result protection behind one contract.

requires.reason: Implements the shared AsyncAction and AsyncActionContext contract.
Supersession and cancellation are delegated rather than reimplemented.
Suppresses indicator flashes for fast work.

suggests.reason: Retry policy is valuable for network-backed actions but pointless for local ones, so it stays opt-in.

rationale: The single contract that buttons, forms, uploads, exports, and agent operations all route through. Without it every async surface reinvents delayed spinners and stale-result handling, inconsistently.
